full_judgment: Latifur Rahman, J.: The plaintiff respondent filed Other Class Suit No. 89 of 1989 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Ishwardi, Pabna. The said suit was decreed on 31.3.93. Against the aforesaid judgment and decree the defendant-petitioner preferred Other Class Appeal No. 91 of 1993 and the appeal was dismissed by the Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Pabna on 13.7.94. Against that appellate judgment and decree the defendant preferred Civil Revision No. 483 of 1995. A learned Single Judge of" the High Court Division discharged the Rule on 1.3.98. The defendant-petitioner having lost in all the courts below has challenged the impugned judgment of the High Court Division.
